name: canvas-pilot
description: Local-first Canvas LMS AI agent that learns each course's recurring assignment workflow and reuses it through scan -> approval -> execute with student review.

paragraphs: Canvas Pilot is an open-source, local-first Canvas LMS AI agent for Codex and Claude Code power users. It learns each course's recurring assignment pattern, then reuses that pattern through scan -> approval -> execute workflows that produce review-ready drafts and run reports.

It is a Canvas MCP workflow layer, not just another Canvas API wrapper. Canvas MCP servers let an agent access Canvas; Canvas Pilot adds recurring course memory, assignment workflow automation, approval boundaries, verification, and student review above the access layer.
The public repo contains the generic framework. Credentials, cookies, private course identifiers, assignment inputs, drafts, and real run outputs stay local and gitignored.
features: A driver-free standalone app. Canvas Pilot is currently a local agent
Supporting LMSes other than Canvas. Each LMS has enough API
A multi-tenant SaaS. Canvas Pilot is a per-user local install.
Operational misuse guidance. Canvas Pilot documents workflow structure,
Academic-integrity arbitration. Whether running this on a given
